title: ConnectRange exemple
body: Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js, I could not find what I was looking for which is: an exemple of use for connectRange.  Some exemples are available for others connectors but not this one.  Thank you for your help

comments.body: You're right, there doesn't seem to be an example. The `rangeSlider` ([widget](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/widgets/range-slider/range-slider.js) using Rheostat) and `rangeInput` ([widget](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/widgets/range-input/range-input.js), [component](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/src/components/RangeInput/RangeInput.js)) use it though, which you can use as "documentation"
thank you I might found what I need there.
Perfect! Will leave open since a real example can not hurt
Thanks for the feedback @timmetj! We are in the process to re-write all our documentation. Each connector will have a dedicated example in the next version.

One more thing (this even might be for all connectors):
the autoHideContainer option doesn't seem to work in connectors? It's not part of the options either, maybe add this? Or add an example how to hide when empty default?
autoHideContainer is part of widgets; meaning that you would implement that yourself in your custom widget. However; we do not even support autoHideContainer in the new widgets in fact
